scope: Primary-source review and bounded exact CPU terminal-risk mechanism trial; not a production-model experiment
user_authorization: Carefully research, then begin a justified bounded attempt

noise.reverse: Per-clean-state normalized production Bayes posterior mixed with predicted clean Bernoulli probability

predictor: Toy shared linear clean-edge logits from relation, current edge, degree, common-neighbor and time features; no reference or node IDs as predictor inputs; NOT O/A network
reference_score: Four equal blocks: relation-count normalized square, per-type anonymous joint relation-degree L1 assignment, typed-triangle normalized square, component-count normalized square. Toy engineering scales only, not adopted PubMed objective.
checks: production kernel and independent Bayes equality including t=1 and fixed support
soft expected triangle equality and missing variance
on-policy single-step clean risk versus terminal gradient
gate: Only run toy optimization if all exact-kernel/gradient/support tests pass within 1e-8; finite-difference tolerance 1e-6. Eager bias is an expected measured limitation, not an implementation failure.
decision: Do not promote a biased surrogate merely because toy score falls. Retain all initialization results and diversity costs. Next real work must first bind exact objective and estimate trajectory cost.
